events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture, began in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock. What was your festival highlight from '69, even if you weren't there?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the day Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away at Graceland in 1977. He would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring its legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history. What's your standout track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde, known for her distinctive voice and songwriting, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! An absolute rock icon. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock and roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years since Apple dropped the original, changing how we listen to music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Fans worldwide celebrate James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', premiering in London in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme song? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen, on the anniversary of his death in 1991. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
